prefix_witness_CEGIS.necessary_condition: dim(T modulo affine)=m; after i prefix ANDs of at most k, target intersection has dimension at least m-(k-i). Use i=k-m+1 and require one nonzero target combination in the prefix span on every input.

base_independent_audit.scope: Independent serialized trace/CNF/model audit only. No new dependent-GF16 lower bound, new AES candidate or world-first claim.
base_independent_audit.review_contract: Point restrictions delete truth equations only, retaining every earlier-signal factor coefficient and unrestricted output decoder. Initial main9points fit affine behavior only; knownnine control37points additionally fixes quadratic coefficients. Zero point is automatic after constant-removal normalization. SAT subsets are not candidates until all rows replay; an UNSAT subset can exclude its fixed first-plane model if solver/certificate is trusted; UNKNOWN/step/time limits exclude nothing.
base_independent_audit.robustness_note: Unused configuration: if total_seconds is too small to attempt any iteration, campaign history[0] raises instead of reporting NOT_ATTEMPTED. Current positive budgets produced nonempty histories, so this does not affect these artifacts.

prefix_independent_audit.dimension_necessity: Let A be affine truth functions and T/A have dimensionm. For any valid<=k-AND circuit V_k containsT and codim(V_p in V_k)<=k-p. Thus dim((T intersect V_p)/A)>=m-(k-p); atp=k-m+1 a nonzero target combination lies in the prefix span. Padding and arbitrary topological ordering preserve the inequality. Free lambda spans all nonzero target combinations.
prefix_independent_audit.encoding_contract: Every prefix gate is evaluated on all nonzero inputs; suffix gates/ordinary output decoder are constrained only at training points. Extra all-input prefix decoder equals a free nonzero target combination. Point0 is automatic after zero-preserving normalization. Witness validity alone is not full candidate correctness.
prefix_independent_audit.scope: Independent CNF/model/full-prefix-witness and finite CEX trace audit only. No timeout exclusion, proof-certificate check, new AES design or novelty claim.

necessary_prefix_condition: For target rank m modulo affine functions, k AND budget and i prefix gates, target/prefix intersection dimension >= m-(k-i). At k8,m4,i5 require one free nonzero target combination in prefix on every input.

base_partial_prefix_rank_diagnostic.scope: Exact concrete-prefix infeasibility certificates for the recorded proposals only. No general eight-gate exclusion; no equivalent-prefix deduplication or output-decoder restriction.

quadratic_product_diagnostic.scope: All quadratic first operands on eight Boolean inputs up to affine input equivalence, and all quadratic second operands whose product remains quadratic. Affine-canonical-form proof is separate; these are full finite kernel checks, not sampling.

compact_quadratic_product_certificates.certificate_method: Check a complete 37-column linear map kernel basis. Multiplication by fixed P is linear in Q, so each recorded image-space property extends from the basis to every kernel element.

independent_compact_check.scope: Independent complete-kernel/image certificate check for the eleven non-affine canonical quadratic P forms on eight inputs. Affine P is an elementary separate case. Canonical-form coverage and circuit-flattening induction are reviewed mathematics, not machine-formalized here. No unrestricted eight-AND exclusion.

higher_degree_escape_condition.statement: A complete eight-AND GF16 multiplier must contain a degree>2 gate truth and at least two gates taking prior nonlinear signals as operands.
higher_degree_escape_condition.proof_scope: Eleven canonical non-affine quadratic-product cases with complete kernel certificates plus the elementary affine case, followed by reviewed canonical-form and circuit-flattening arguments. Not a proof-assistant formalization.

new_primary_source.author: Gregory Morse
new_primary_source.checked: Abstract states unrestricted nine-AND complexity of seven-output unreduced four-term polynomial multiplication. Abstract reviewed; Lean artifact not executed.
new_primary_source.nontransfer: GF16 is a four-output linear projection, so its complexity is at most polynomial multiplication complexity; this cannot transfer the lower bound backward.
